translated: So it was you after all, Lenneth...

I sensed your presence in Dipan as well...
Did Fray call you here?

I am not a valkyrie.
I am Lenneth, the creator god.

I came from another future
to save my own world.

After Ragnarok...
a world without Odin.

Does this have something to do with
the time control device in Dipan Castle?
It was not me... it was Lezard.

He is a heretic who came from
my time <PART> ---- <PART> the future.

I meant to seal it away from humans,
but I should have destroyed it after all.
Because of that, my world has begun to fall apart.

She was supposed to be saved by you.
The cause lies without a doubt with Lezard.
